title: domain (i.e. field)
description: Attribute domains are rules that describe the legal values of a field type, providing a method for enforcing data integrity. Attribute domains are used to constrain the values allowed in a particular attribute. Using domains helps ensure data integrity by limiting the choice of values for a particular field. Attribute domains can be shared across scene layers like 3D Object scene layers or Building Scene Layers.

name.description: Name of the domain. Must be unique per Scene Layer.

fieldType.description: The field type is the type of attribute field with which the domain can be associated. Possible values are: `esriFieldTypeDate`esriFieldTypeSingle`esriFieldTypeDouble`esriFieldTypeInteger`esriFieldTypeSmallInteger`esriFieldTypeString`

range.description: Range of the domain. Only numeric types are possible.

codedValues.description: Range of the domain. Only string types are possible.

mergePolicy.description: Merge policy for the domain. Not used by Scene Layers. Possible values are: `esriMPTDefaultValue`esriMPTSumValues`esriMPTAreaWeighted`

splitPolicy.description: Split policy for the domain. Not used by Scene Layers. Possible values are: `esriSPTGeometryRatio`esriSPTDuplicate`esriSPTDefaultValue`
